digest.component_or_area: completion verifier resumption and search-frontier exclusion mechanism
propositions: Handing resumption attempts the prior attempt's search frontier as an exclusion list does not reduce re-search overlap by >=30% relative to cache-seeded control on tested tickets; measured overlap increased on both corpus tickets (45c1 +78%, 8d74 +60%).
Data-shaped frontier evidence blocks inserted inside untrusted fenced context are rendered inert by fence design and do not suppress re-verification of unproven criteria.
Frontier blocks act as signposts, causing models to immediately re-read files already listed, raising measured re-search overlap rather than reducing it.

The cache-seeding mechanism (locust behavior) already removes the dominant redundancy by skipping re-verification of credited criteria; remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be efficiently suppressed by untrusted exclusion-list hints.
Argument-level tool-call transcripts are not carried in production verifier telemetry; capturing them required harness-side monkeypatching of tool executors and completion_recovery bindings.
